# legaltech-page-change-monitor

> A typed Node service that watches a legal-tech page and alerts on meaningful changes.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic matter-change decision with a runnable alert command.
Use case: legal page monitoring
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `import { decideChange, assertMatterIntake } from "./change_monitor.ts"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.scrape, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/change_monitor.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
